proposal.summary: An integer overflow in RELIC (before commit 34580d8) in bn_grow when calling realloc can allow attackers to execute arbitrary code, cause denial of service, or escalate privileges.
proposal.cwe_quote: Integer Overflow vulnerability in RELIC before commit 34580d840469361ba9b5f001361cad659687b9ab, allows attackers to execute arbitrary code, cause a denial of service, and escalate privileges when calling realloc function in bn_grow function.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the vulnerable commit range and reproduce the issue by exercising bn_grow with large inputs; review the realloc size calculation and apply integer overflow checks; backport the upstream patch and notify downstream consumers to update.
